## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Tests added or changed with the code, and the checks for the parts I touched pass
      (`npm run check`, `cargo test`, `swift test`, the app schemes).
- [ ] An API change updates `docs/api.md`, the server and LobbyKit together.
- [ ] A choice the docs left open has an entry in `docs/decisions.md`.
- [ ] No private data in code, tests or docs (names, hosts, file names from a real library).
- [ ] New source files start with `SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0`.
